title: Unique Paths II
summary: Count routes from the upper-left cell to the lower-right cell, moving only down or right.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100 rows and columns, with every entry 0 or 1. The number of complete routes is at most 2000000000.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare the exact path count. An unreachable or blocked destination gives zero. Saturate intermediate counts only at the stated maximum final count.

statement: Count routes from the upper-left cell to the lower-right cell, moving only down or right. A 1 marks a cell that cannot be entered. A 0 is traversable. Return zero if the start or destination is blocked.

examples.explanation: Only the top route can reach the last column.
The moves may occur in either order.

constraints: 1–100 rows and columns, with every entry 0 or 1. The number of complete routes is at most 2000000000.
hints: Conceptual: A cell can be reached only from its upper or left neighbor.
Directional: Keep one running count per column.
Implementation: Reset blocked cells to zero. For every open cell, add its count from above to its current left neighbor’s count.
complexityAnalysis: O(rows×columns) time and O(columns) auxiliary space.
